p1260 (Bypass configuration), r1261 (Bypass control/status word), p1266 (Bypass, control command),
p1267 (Bypass changeover source configuration), p1269 (Bypass switch feedback signal), p1274 (Bypass switch
monitoring time)

nume: Drive: Automatic restart interrupted
cauza:
- The specified number of restart attempts (p1211) has been completely used up because within the monitoring time
(p1213) the faults were not able to be acknowledged. The number of restart attempts (p1211) is decremented at each
new start attempt.
- there is no active ON command.
- the monitoring time for the power unit has expired (p0857).
- when exiting commissioning or at the end of the motor identification routine or the speed controller optimization, the
drive unit is not automatically powered up again.
remediu:
- increase the number of restart attempts (p1211). The actual number of starting attempts is displayed in r1214.
- increase the delay time in p1212 and/or the monitoring time in p1213.
- issue an ON command (p0840).
- either increase or disable the monitoring time of the power unit (p0857).
- Reduce the waiting time for resetting the fault counter p1213[1] so that fewer faults are registered in the time inter-
val.

extra.fault_value: Only for internal Siemens troubleshooting.

nume: Drive: Automatic restart active
cauza:
The automatic restart (AR) is active. When the line supply returns and/or the causes of the existing faults are
removed the drive is automatically restarted. The pulses are enabled and the motor starts to rotate.
remediu:
- the automatic restart (AR) should, if required, be inhibited (p1210 = 0).
- an automatic restart can be directly interrupted by withdrawing the power-on command (BI: p0840).

nume: Flying restart: Measured search current too low
cauza:
During a flying restart, it was identified that the search current reached is too low.
It is possible that the motor is not connected.
remediu: Check the motor feeder cables.

nume: FlyRestart: Not supported
cauza:
It is not possible to power up with the motor rotating (no flying restart). In the following cases, the "flying restart" func-
tion is not supported:
Permanent-magnet and separately-excited synchronous motors (PEM, FEM): Operation with V/f characteristic.
Permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PEM): Encoderless operation without a Voltage Sensing Module (VSM)
being connected.
remediu:
- deactivate the "flying restart" function (p1200 = 0).
- change the open-loop/closed-loop control mode (p1300).
- connect a Voltage Sensing Module (VSM) (voltage measurement).

nume: Drive: Measuring probe parameterized to a digital output
cauza: The measuring probe is connected to a bi-directional digital input/output and the terminal is set as output.
remediu:
- set the terminal as input (p0728).
- deselect the measuring probe (p0488, p0489, p0580).

extra.alarm_value:
8: DI/DO 8 (X122.9/X132.1)
9: DI/DO 9 (X122.10/X132.2)
10: DI/DO 10 (X122.12/X132.3)
11: DI/DO 11 (X122.13/X132.4)
12: DI/DO 12 (X132.9)
13: DI/DO 13 (X132.10)
14: DI/DO 14 (X132.12)
15: DI/DO 15 (X132.13)
To the terminal designation:
The first designation is valid for CU320, the second for CU305.

nume: Drive: DC link voltage maximum controller active
cauza:
The DC link voltage controller has been activated because the upper switch-in threshold has been exceeded (r1242,
r1282).
The ramp-down times are automatically increased in order to maintain the DC link voltage (r0070) within the permis-
sible limits. There is a system deviation between the setpoint and actual speeds.
When the DC link voltage controller is switched out (disabled), this is the reason that the ramp-function generator
output is set to the speed actual value.
remediu:
If the controller is not to intervene:
- increase the ramp-down times.
- shut down the Vdc_max controller (p1280 = 0).
If the ramp-down times are not to be changed:
- use a chopper or regenerative feedback unit.

extra.see_also:
p1240 (Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration), p1280 (Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configu-
ration (V/f))

nume: Drive: DC link voltage maximum controller deactivated
cauza:
The Vdc_max controller can no longer maintain the DC link voltage (r0070) below the limit value (r1242, r1282) and
was therefore switched out (disabled).
- the line supply voltage is permanently higher than specified for the power unit.
- the motor is permanently in the regenerative mode as a result of a load that is driving the motor.
remediu:
- check whether the input voltage is within the permissible range.
- check whether the load duty cycle and load limits are within the permissible limits.

nume: Drive: DC link voltage minimum controller active
cauza:
The DC link voltage controller has been activated as the lower switch-in threshold has been undershot (r1246,
r1286).
The kinetic energy of the motor is used to buffer the DC link. The drive is therefore braked.
remediu: The alarm disappears when power supply returns.

extra.see_also:
r0056 (Status word, closed-loop control), p1240 (Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration), p1280
(Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration (V/f))

nume: Drive: Lower DC link voltage threshold reached
cauza:
The DC link voltage monitoring is active (p1240 , p1280 = 5, 6) and the lower DC link voltage threshold (r1246, r1286)
was reached in the "Operation" state.
remediu:
- check the line supply voltage.
- check the infeed module
- adapt the device supply voltage (p0210) or the switch-on level (p1245, p1285).
- disable the DC link voltage monitoring (p1240, p1280 = 0).

nume: Drive: Upper DC link voltage threshold reached
cauza:
The DC link voltage monitoring is active (p1240 , p1280 = 4, 6) and the upper DC link voltage threshold (r1242,
r1282) was reached in the "Operation" state.
remediu:
- check the line supply voltage.
- check the infeed module
- adapt the device supply voltage (p0210).
- disable the DC link voltage monitoring (p1240, p1280 = 0).

nume: Drive: Kinetic buffering minimum speed not reached
cauza:
During kinetic buffering the speed fell below minimum speed (p1257 or p1297 for vector drives with V/f control) and
the line supply did not return.
remediu: Check the speed threshold for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering) (p1257, p1297).
reactie: OFF2 (IASC/DCBRAKE, NONE, OFF1, OFF3, STOP1, STOP2)

extra.see_also: p1257 (Vdc_min controller speed threshold)

nume: Drive: Kinetic buffering maximum time exceeded
cauza:
The maximum buffer time (p1255 and p1295 for vector drives with V/f control) has been exceeded without the line
supply having returned.
remediu: Check the time threshold for Vdc-min controller (kinetic buffering) (p1255, p1295).
reactie: OFF3 (IASC/DCBRAKE, NONE, OFF1, OFF2, STOP1, STOP2)

extra.see_also: p1255 (Vdc_min controller time threshold)

nume: Drive: V/f control, current limiting controller active
cauza: The current limiting controller of the V/f control was activated because the current limit was exceeded.
remediu:
The alarm is automatically withdrawn when increasing the current limit (p0640), reducing the load or using a slower
up ramp for the setpoint (reference) speed.

nume: Drive: Current controller output limited
cauza:
The condition "I_act = 0 and Uq_set_1 longer than 16 ms at its limit" is present and can be caused by the following:
- motor not connected or motor contactor open.
- motor data and motor configuration (star-delta) do not match.
- no DC link voltage present.
- power unit defective.
- the "flying restart" function is not activated.
remediu:
- connect the motor or check the motor contactor.
- check the motor parameterization and the connection configuration (star-delta).
- check the DC link voltage (r0070).
- check the power unit.
- activate the "flying restart" function (p1200).

nume: Drive: Flux setpoint not reached when building up excitation
cauza:
When quick magnetizing is configured (p1401.6 = 1) the specified flux setpoint is not reached although 90% of the
maximum current is specified.
- incorrect motor data.
- motor data and motor configuration (star-delta) do not match.
- the current limit has been set too low for the motor.
- induction motor (encoderless, open-loop controlled) in I2t limiting.
- the Motor Module is too small.
- the magnetizing time p0346 is too short.
remediu:
- correct the motor data. Perform motor data identification and rotating measurement.
- check the motor configuration.
- correct the current limits (p0640).
- reduce the induction motor load.
- if required, use a larger Motor Module.
- check motor supply cable.
- check power unit.
- increase p0346.

nume: Drive: Commutation angle incorrect (motor model)
cauza:
An incorrect commutation angle was detected that can result in a positive coupling in the speed controller.
Possible causes:
- the motor encoder is incorrectly adjusted with respect to the magnet position.
- the motor encoder is damaged.
- the angular commutation offset is incorrectly set (p0431).
- data to calculate the motor model has been incorrectly set (p0356 (motor-stator leakage inductance) and/or p0350
(motor-stator resistance) and/or p0352 (cable resistance).
- the changeover speed for the motor model is too low (p1752). The monitoring function only becomes effective
above the changeover speed.
- pole position identification might have calculated an incorrect value when activated (p1982 = 1).
- the motor encoder speed signal is faulted.
- the control loop is instable due to incorrect parameterization.
remediu:
- if the encoder mounting was changed - re-adjust the encoder.
- replace the defective motor encoder.
- correctly set the angular commutation offset (p0431).
- correctly set the motor stator resistance, cable resistance and motor-stator leakage inductance (p0350, p0352,
p0356).
- increase the changeover speed for the motor model (p1752). The monitoring is completely deactivated for p1752
> p1082 (maximum speed).
- with pole position identification activated (p1982 = 1) check the procedure for pole position identification (p1980)
and force a new pole position identification procedure by means of deselection followed by selection (p1982 = 0 -> 1).

extra.fault_value:
SERVO:
0: The comparison of the pole position angle from the encoder and the motor model resulted in an excessively high
value (> 80 ° electrical).
1: -
VECTOR:
0: The comparison of the pole position angle from the encoder and the motor model resulted in an excessively high
value (> 45 ° electrical).
1: The change in the speed signal from the motor encoder has changed by > p0492 within a current controller clock
cycle.
extra.note:
For High Dynamic Motors (1FK7xxx-7xxx), for applications with a higher current, if necessary, the monitoring should
be disabled.

nume: Drive: Commutation angle incorrect (pole position identification)
cauza:
An incorrect commutation angle was detected that can result in a positive coupling in the speed controller.
- within the pole position identification routine (p1982 = 2):
A difference of > 45° electrical to the encoder angle was determined.
- for VECTOR, within the encoder adjustment (p1990 = 2):
A difference of > 6 ° electrical to the encoder angle was determined.
remediu:
- correctly set the angular commutation offset (p0431).
- re-adjust the motor encoder after the encoder has been replaced.
- replace the defective motor encoder.
- check the pole position identification routine. If the pole position identification routine is not suitable for this motor
type, then disable the plausibility check (p1982 = 0).

nume: Drive: Flux controller configuration
cauza: The configuration of the flux control (p1401) is contradictory.
remediu:
Re fault cause = 1:
- Shut down soft start (p1401.0 = 0).
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).
Re fault cause = 2:
- De-energize flux build-up control (p1401.2 = 0).
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).
Re fault cause = 3:
- Re-parameterize Rs identification (p0621 = 0, 1)
- Shut down quick magnetizing (p1401.6 = 0).

extra.alarm_value:
ccbbaaaa hex
aaaa = Parameter
bb = Index
cc = fault cause
cc = 01 hex = 1 dec:
Quick magnetizing (p1401.6) for soft start (p1401.0).
cc = 02 hex = 2 dec:
Quick magnetizing (p1401.6) for flux build-up control (p1401.2).
cc = 03 hex = 3 dec:
Quick magnetizing (p1401.6) for Rs identification after restart (p0621 = 2).

nume: Drive: Pulse technique not plausible (motor model)
cauza: The evaluation of the test pulse response found incorrect values.
remediu:
Re fault value 0:
Once the pulse technique has been deselected automatically (p1750.5=0), there are two possible options:
- acknowledge the fault and save parameter p1750.5=0 => field-oriented control mode to standstill is forfeited and
replaced by transition to open-loop control at low speeds.
- replace the power unit firmware (at least V4.30) => field-oriented control mode to standstill is available.
Re fault value 10:
With active selection of the pulse technique (p1750.5)
- power both the CU and the power unit component down and then back up again, or
- perform a manual warm restart (see P0009, P0976).
If this does not solve the problem: Replace the power unit component.
Re fault value 20:
- control parameters might have been adjusted (factory setting, commissioning).
- filters must not be connected between motor and converter/inverter.
- check the motor.

extra.fault_value:
An impermissible pulse technique configuration was detected during ramp-up.
Possible causes:
- The pulse technique was initially selected during system ramp-up (p1750.5=1) but the
power unit component does not support the current oversampling required (see r192.23).
As a consequence, p1750.0 was deselected automatically.
The pulse response is repeatedly implausible.
Possible causes:
- Incorrect configuration of the power unit component
- The power unit component is faulty.
At the preset pulse amplitude the measured pulse response is much higher than the expected value.
Possible causes:
- The orientation loop has been affected by major vibration phenomena.
- The motor is short-circuited for high frequencies (output filter).
- The motor is damaged.

nume: Drive: Reference model natural frequency > Shannon frequency
cauza:
The natural filter frequency of the PT2 element for the reference model (p1433) is greater than the Shannon fre-
quency.
The Shannon frequency is calculated according to the following formula: 0.5 / p0115[1]
remediu:
- reduce the natural frequency of PT2 element for reference model (p1433).
- reduce the speed controller sampling time (p0115[1]).

nume: Technology controller actual value limited
cauza:
The actual signal of the technology controller has reached its limit.
- Fault value = 1: upper limit reached
- Fault value = 2: lower limit reached
remediu:
- Adapt the limits in P2267, P2268 to the signal level.
- Check scaling of the actual signal.

extra.see_also:
p2264 (Technology controller actual value), p2267 (Technology controller upper limit actual value), p2268
(Technology controller lower limit actual value)

nume: Drive: It is not possible to change the direction of rotation with the pulses enabled
cauza:
A drive data set was selected - with the pulses enabled - which has a different parameterized direction of rotation
(p1821).
It is only possible to change the motor direction of rotation using p1821 when the pulses are inhibited.
remediu:
- change over the drive data set with the pulses inhibited.
- ensure that the changeover to a drive data set does not result in the motor direction of rotation being changed (i.e.
for these drive data sets, the same value must be in p1821).

extra.see_also: p1821 (Dir of rot)

nume: Drive: Setting the ramp-function generator for encoderless vector control
cauza:
During operation with encoderless vector control (r1407.1) the ramp-function generator was stopped (p1141) or
bypassed (p1122). An internal setting command of the ramp-function generator output caused the set setpoint speed
to be frozen or was not able to be realized.
remediu:
- deactivate the holding command for the ramp-function generator (p1141).
- do not bypass the ramp-function generator (p1122).
- suppress the fault (p2101, p2119). This is necessary if the ramp-function generator is held using jogging and the
speed setpoint is simultaneously inhibited (r0898.6).

extra.note:
For encoderless vector control it is not practical to read-in the main setpoint of the speed control via p1155 or p1160
(p0922). In this case, the main setpoint should be injected before the ramp-function generator (p1070). The reason
for this is that the ramp-function generator output is automatically set when transitioning from closed-loop speed con-
trolled into open-loop speed controlled operation.

nume: EPOS: Jerk time is limited
cauza:
The calculation of the jerk time Tr = MAX(p2572, p2573) / p2574 resulted in an excessively high value so that the
jerk time is internally limited to 1000 ms.
remediu:
- increase the jerk limiting (p2574).
- reduce maximum acceleration or maximum deceleration (p2572, p2573).

extra.note: The alarm is also output if jerk limiting is not active.

nume: LR: Save the position offset of the absolute encoder adjustment
cauza:
The status of the absolute encoder adjustment has changed.
In order to permanently save the determined position offset (p2525) it must be saved in a non-volatile fashion (p0971,
p0977).
remediu:
None necessary.
This alarm automatically disappears after the offset has been saved.

nume: LR: Multiturn does not match the modulo range
cauza:
The ratio between the multiturn resolution and the modulo range (p2576) is not an integer number.
This results in the adjustment being set back, as the position actual value cannot be reproduced after power-
off/power-on.
remediu:
Make the ration between the multiturn resolution and the modulo range an integer number.
The ratio v is calculated as follows:
1. Motor encoder without position tracking:
v = (p0421 * p2506 * p0433 * p2505) / (p0432 * p2504 * p2576)
2. Motor encoder with position tracking for the measuring gear:
v = (p0412 * p2506 * p2505) / (p2504 * p2576)
3. Motor encoder with position tracking for the load gear:
v = (p2721 * p2506 * p0433) / (p0432 * p2576)
4. Motor encoder with position tracking for the load and measuring gear:
v = (p2721 * p2506) / p2576
5. Direct encoder without position tracking:
v = (p0421 * p2506 * p0433) / (p0432 * p2576)
6. Direct encoder with position tracking for the measuring gear:
v = (p0412 * p2506) / p2576

extra.see_also:
p0412 (Measuring gear, absolute encoder, rotary, revolutions, virtual), p0432 (Gearbox factor, encoder
revolutions), p0433 (Gearbox factor, motor/load revolutions), p2721 (Load gear, rotary absolute gearbox, revolu-
tions, virtual)
extra.note: With position tracking, it is recommended that p0412 and p2721 are changed

nume: LR: Reference point coordinate not in the permissible range
cauza:
The reference point coordinate received when adjusting the encoder via connector input p2599 lies outside the half
of the encoder range and cannot be set as actual axis position.
remediu: Set the reference point coordinate to a lower value than specified in the fault value.

extra.fault_value: Maximum permissible value for the reference point coordinate.

nume: Load gear: Position tracking cannot be reset
cauza: The position tracking cannot be reset.
remediu:
Reset the position tracking as follows:
- select encoder commissioning (p0010 = 4).
- reset position tracking, position (p2720.2 = 1).
- deselect encoder commissioning (p0010 = 0).
The fault should then be acknowledged and, if necessary, the absolute encoder adjusted (p2507).

nume: Load gear: Position tracking, maximum actual value exceeded
cauza:
When the position tracking of the load gear is configured, the drive/encoder (motor encoder) identifies a maximum
possible absolute position actual value (r2723) that can no longer be represented within 32 bits.
Maximum value: p0408 * p2721 * 2^p0419
remediu:
- reduce the fine resolution (p0419).
- reduce the multiturn resolution (p2721).

extra.message_value: Component number: %1, encoder data set: %2, drive data set: %3
extra.fault_value:
ccbbaa hex
aa = encoder data set
bb = component number
cc = drive data set
extra.see_also:
p0408 (Rotary encoder pulse No.), p0419 (Fine resolution absolute value Gx_XIST2 (in bits)), p2721 (Load
gear, rotary absolute gearbox, revolutions, virtual)
p0419 (Fine resolution absolute value Gx_XIST2 (in bits)), p2721 (Load gear, rotary absolute gearbox,
revolutions, virtual)

nume: Load gear: Position tracking, linear axis has exceeded the maximum range
cauza:
For a configured linear axis/no modulo axis, the currently effective motor encoder (encoder 1) has exceeded the
maximum possible traversing range.
For the configured linear axis, the maximum traversing range is defined to be 64x (+/- 32x) of p0421. It should be
read in p2721 and interpreted as the number of load revolutions.
remediu:
The fault should be resolved as follows:
- select encoder commissioning (p0010 = 4).
- reset position tracking, position (p2720.2 = 1).
- deselect encoder commissioning (p0010 = 0).
The fault should then be acknowledged and the absolute encoder adjusted.

extra.note:
Only the motor encoder in the currently effective drive data set is monitored here. The actual effective drive data set
is displayed in x = r0051 and the corresponding motor encoder is specified in in p0187[x].

nume: Load gear: Position tracking, actual position outside tolerance window
cauza:
When powered down, the currently effective motor encoder was moved through a distance greater than was param-
eterized in the tolerance window. It is possible that there is no longer any reference between the mechanical system
and encoder.
remediu:
Reset the position tracking as follows:
- select encoder commissioning (p0010 = 4).
- reset position tracking, position (p2720.2 = 1).
- deselect encoder commissioning (p0010 = 0).
The fault should then be acknowledged and, if necessary, the absolute encoder adjusted (p2507).

extra.fault_value:
Deviation (difference) to the last encoder position in increments of the absolute value after the measuring gear - if
one is being used. The sign designates the traversing direction.
extra.see_also:
p2722 (Load gear, position tracking tolerance window), r2724 (Load gear position difference)
p0010
extra.note:
Only the motor encoder in the currently effective drive data set is monitored here. The actual effective drive data set
is displayed in x = r0051 and the corresponding motor encoder is specified in in p0187[x].
The deviation (difference) found is also displayed in r2724.

nume: LR: Standstill monitoring has responded
cauza:
After the standstill monitoring time (p2543) expired, the drive left the standstill window (p2542).
- position actual value inversion incorrectly set (p0410).
- standstill window set too small (p2542).
- standstill monitoring time set too low (p2543).
- position loop gain too low (p2538).
- position loop gain too high (instability/oscillation, p2538).
- mechanical overload.
- check the connecting cable, motor/drive converter (phase missing, interchange).
- when selecting motor identification, select tracking mode (BI: p2655[0] = 1 signal).
- when selecting function generator, select tracking mode (BI: p2655[0] = 1 signal) and deactivate position control
(BI:p2550 = 0 signal).
remediu: Check the causes and resolve.

nume: LR: Position monitoring has responded
cauza:
When the position monitoring time (p2545) expired, the drive had still not reached the positioning window (p2544).
- positioning window parameterized too small (p2544).
- position monitoring time parameterized too short (p2545).
- position loop gain too low (p2538).
- position loop gain too high (instability/oscillation, p2538).
- drive mechanically locked.
remediu: Check the causes and resolve.

nume: LR: Following error too high
cauza:
The difference between the position setpoint position actual value (following error dynamic model, r2563) is greater
than the tolerance (p2546).
- the drive torque or accelerating capacity exceeded.
- position measuring system fault.
- position control sense incorrect.
- mechanical system locked.
- excessively high traversing velocity or excessively high position reference value (setpoint) differences
remediu: Check the causes and resolve.

nume: LR: Position actual value preprocessing error
cauza: An error has occurred during the position actual value preprocessing.
remediu: Check the encoder for the position actual value preprocessing.

nume: LR: Position actual value preprocessing does not have a valid encoder
cauza:
One of the following problems has occurred with the position actual value preprocessing:
- an encoder is not assigned for the position actual value preprocessing (p2502 = 0).
- an encoder is assigned, but no encoder data set (p0187 = 99 or p0188 = 99 or p0189 = 99).
- an encoder an an encoder data set have been assigned, however, the encoder data set does not contain any
encoder data (p0400 = 0) or invalid data (e.g. p0408 = 0).
remediu: Check the drive data sets, encoder data sets and encoder assignment.

extra.see_also:
p0187 (Encoder 1 encoder data set number), p0188 (Encoder 2 encoder data set number), p0189
(Encoder 3 encoder data set number), p0400 (Encoder type selection)

nume: EPOS: Maximum velocity limited
cauza:
The maximum velocity (p2571) is too high to correctly calculate the modulo correction.
Within the sampling time for positioning (p0115[5]), with the maximum velocity, a maximum of the half modulo length
must be moved through. p2571 was limited to this value.
remediu:
- reduce the maximum velocity (p2571).
- increase the sampling time for positioning (p0115[5]).

nume: EPOS: Setpoint velocity limited
cauza: The actual setpoint velocity is greater than the parameterized maximum velocity (p2571) and is therefore limited.
remediu:
- check the entered setpoint velocity.
- reduce the velocity override (CI: p2646).
- increase the maximum velocity (p2571).
- check the signal source for the externally limited velocity (CI: p2594).

nume: EPOS: Combination of input signals illegal
cauza: An illegal combination of input signals that are simultaneously set was identified.
remediu: Check the appropriate input signals and correct.

extra.alarm_value:
0: Jog 1 and jog 2 (p2589, p2590).
1: Jog 1 or jog 2 and direct setpoint input/MDI (p2589, p2590, p2647).
2: Jog 1 or jog 2 and start referencing (p2589, p2590, p2595).
3: Jog 1 or jog 2 and activate traversing task (p2589, p2590, p2631).
4: Direct setpoint input/MDI and starting referencing (p2647, p2595).
5: Direct setpoint input/MDI and activate traversing task (p2647, p2631).
6: Start referencing and activate traversing task (p2595, p2631).

nume: EPOS: Reference cam not found
cauza:
After starting the search for reference, the axis moved through the maximum permissible distance to search for the
reference cam without actually finding the reference cam.
remediu:
- check the "reference cam" binector input (BI: p2612).
- check the maximum permissible distance to the reference cam (p2606).
- if axis does not have any reference cam, then set p2607 to 0.

nume: EPOS: No zero mark
cauza:
After leaving the reference cam, the axis has traversed the maximum permissible distance between the reference
cam and zero mark without finding the zero mark.
remediu:
- check the encoder regarding the zero mark
- check the maximum permissible distance between the reference cam and zero mark (p2609).
- use an external encoder zero mark (equivalent zero mark) (p0495).

extra.see_also: p0495 (Equivalent zero mark, input terminal)

nume: EPOS: End of reference cam not found
cauza:
During the search for reference, when the axis reached the zero mark it also reached the end of the traversing range
without detecting an edge at the binector input "reference cam" (BI: p2612).
Maximum traversing range: -2147483648 [LU] ... -2147483647 [LU]
remediu:
- check the "reference cam" binector input (BI: p2612).
- repeat the search for reference.

nume: EPOS: Reference point not set
cauza: When starting a traversing block/direct setpoint input, a reference point is not set (r2684.11 = 0).
remediu: Reference the system (search for reference, flying referencing, set reference point).

nume: EPOS: Selected traversing block number does not exist
cauza:
A traversing block selected via BI: p2625 to BI: p2630 was started via BI: p2631 = 0/1 edge "Activate traversing task".
- the number of the started traversing block is not contained in p2616[0...n].
- the started traversing block is suppressed.
remediu:
- correct the traversing program.
- select an available traversing block number.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the selected traversing block that is also not available.

nume: EPOS: External block change not requested in the traversing block
cauza:
For a traversing block with the block change enable CONTINUE_EXTERNAL_ALARM, the external block change
was not requested.
remediu: Resolve the reason as to why the edge is missing at binector input (BI: p2632).

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block is inconsistent
cauza: The traversing block does not contain valid information.
remediu: Check the traversing block and where relevant, take into consideration alarms that are present.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with invalid information.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block does not have a subsequent block
cauza: There is no subsequent block in the traversing block.
remediu:
- parameterize this traversing block with the block change enable END.
- parameterize additional traversing blocks with a higher block number and for the last block, using the block change
enable END.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with the missing subsequent block.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block number assigned a multiple number of times
cauza: The same traversing block number was assigned a multiple number of times.
remediu: Correct the traversing blocks.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block that was assigned a multiple number of times.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block has illegal task parameters
cauza: The task parameter in the traversing block contains an illegal value.
remediu: Correct the task parameter in the traversing block.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with an illegal task parameter.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block jump destination does not exist
cauza: In a traversing block, a jump was programmed to a non-existent block.
remediu:
- correct the traversing block.
- add the missing traversing block.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with a jump destination that does not exist.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block < target position < software limit switch minus
cauza:
In the traversing block the specified absolute target position lies outside the range limited by the software limit switch
minus.
remediu:
- correct the traversing block.
- change software limit switch minus (CI: p2578, p2580).

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with illegal target position.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block> target position > software limit switch plus
cauza:
In the traversing block the specified absolute target position lies outside the range limited by the software limit switch
plus.
remediu:
- correct the traversing block.
- change software limit switch plus (CI: p2579, p2581).

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with illegal target position.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block target position outside the modulo range
cauza: In the traversing block the target position lies outside the modulo range.
remediu:
- in the traversing block, correct the target position.
- change the modulo range (p2576).

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with illegal target position.

nume: EPOS: Traversing block ABS_POS/ABS_NEG not possible
cauza:
In the traversing block the positioning mode ABS_POS or ABS_NEG were parameterized with the modulo correction
not activated.
remediu: Correct the traversing block.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the traversing block with the illegal positioning mode.

nume: EPOS: Beginning of traversing range reached
cauza: When traversing, the axis has moved to the traversing range limit.
remediu: Move away in the positive direction.

nume: EPOS: End of traversing range reached
cauza: When traversing, the axis has moved to the traversing range limit.
remediu: Move away in the negative direction.

nume: EPOS: Target position < start of traversing range
cauza: The target position for relative traversing lies outside the traversing range.
remediu: Correct the target position.

nume: EPOS: Target position > end of the traversing range
cauza: The target position for relative traversing lies outside the traversing range.
remediu: Correct the target position.

nume: EPOS: Target position < software limit switch minus
cauza: In the actual traversing operation, the target position is less than the software limit switch minus.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch minus (CI: p2578, p2580).

nume: EPOS: Target position > software limit switch plus
cauza: In the actual traversing operation, the target position is greater than the software limit switch plus.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch plus (CI: p2579, p2581).

nume: EPOS: Software limit switch minus reached
cauza: The axis is at the position of the software limit switch minus. An active traversing block was interrupted.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch minus (CI: p2578, p2580).

nume: EPOS: Software limit switch plus reached
cauza: The axis is at the position of the software limit switch plus. An active traversing block was interrupted.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch plus (CI: p2579, p2581).

nume: EPOS: Axis position < software limit switch minus
cauza: The actual position of the axis is less than the position of the software limit switch minus.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch minus (CI: p2578, p2580).

nume: EPOS: Axis position > software limit switch plus
cauza: The actual position of the axis is greater than the position of the software limit switch plus.
remediu:
- correct the target position.
- change software limit switch plus (CI: p2579, p2581).

nume: EPOS: Travel to fixed stop clamping torque not reached
cauza: The fixed stop in the traversing block was reached without the clamping torque/clamping force having been achieved.
remediu:
- Check the maximum torque-generating current (r1533).
- check the torque limits (p1520, p1521).
- check the power limits (p1530, p1531).
- check the BICO interconnections of the torque limits (p1522, p1523, p1528, p1529).

nume: EPOS: Fixed stop outside the monitoring window
cauza: In the "fixed stop reached" state, the axis has moved outside the defined monitoring window (p2635).
remediu:
- check the monitoring window (p2635).
- check the mechanical system.

nume: EPOS: Fixed stop not reached
cauza: In a traversing block with the task FIXED STOP, the end position was reached without detecting a fixed stop.
remediu:
- check the traversing block and locate the target position further into the workpiece.
- check the "fixed stop reached" control signal (p2637).
- if required, reduce the maximum following error window to detect the fixed stop (p2634).

nume: EPOS: Intermediate stop missing
cauza:
In the modes "traversing blocks" or "direct setpoint input/MDI" at the start of motion, the binector input "no interme-
diate stop/intermediate stop" (BI: p2640) did not have a 1 signal.
remediu: Connect a 1 signal to the binector input "no intermediate stop/intermediate stop" (BI: p2640) and re-start motion.

nume: EPOS: Reject traversing task missing
cauza:
In the modes "traversing blocks" or "direct setpoint input/MDI" at the start of motion, the binector input "do not reject
traversing task/reject traversing task" (BI: p2641) does not have a 1 signal.
remediu:
Connect a 1 signal to the binector input "do not reject traversing task/reject traversing task" (BI: p2641) and restart
motion.

nume: EPOS: Relative positioning not possible
cauza:
In the mode "direct setpoint input/MDI", for continuous transfer (p2649 = 1) relative positioning was selected (BI:
p2648 = 0 signal).
remediu: Check the control.

nume: EPOS: Reference point correction outside the window
cauza:
For the function "flying referencing" the difference between the measured position at the measuring probe and the
reference point coordinate lies outside the parameterized window.
remediu:
- check the mechanical system.
- check the parameterization of the window (p2602).

nume: EPOS: Enable signal withdrawn while traversing
cauza:
- for a standard assignment, another fault may have occurred as a result of withdrawing the enable signals.
- the drive is in the "switching on inhibited" state (for a standard assignment).
remediu:
- set the enable signals or check the cause of the fault that first occurred and then result (for a standard assignment).
- check the assignment to enable the basic positioning function.

nume: EPOS: STOP cam minus reached
cauza:
A zero signal was detected at binector input BI: p2569, i.e. the STOP cam minus was reached.
For a positive traversing direction, the STOP cam minus was reached - i.e. the wiring of the STOP cam is incorrect.
remediu:
- leave the STOP cam minus in the positive traversing direction and return the axis to the valid traversing range.
- check the wiring of the STOP cam.

nume: EPOS: STOP cam plus reached
cauza:
A zero signal was detected at binector input BI: p2570, i.e. the STOP cam plus was reached.
For a negative traversing direction, the STOP cam plus was reached - i.e. the wiring of the STOP cam is incorrect.
remediu:
- leave the STOP cam plus in the negative traversing direction and return the axis to the valid traversing range.
- check the wiring of the STOP cam.

nume: LR: Overflow of the value range for position actual value
cauza:
The value range (-2147483648 ... 2147483647) for the position actual value representation was exceeded.
When the overflow occurs, the "referenced" or "adjustment absolute measuring system" status is reset.
remediu:
If required, reduce the traversing range or position resolution (p2506).
Increase the fine resolution of absolute position actual value (p0419).
Reference to fault value = 3:
If the value for the maximum possible absolute position (LU) is greater than 4294967296, then it is not possible to
make an adjustment due to an overflow.
For rotary encoders, the maximum possible absolute position (LU) is calculated as follows:
1. Motor encoder without position tracking
p2506 * p0433 * p2505 / (p0432 * p2504)
p2506 * p0433 * p2505 * p0421 / (p0432 * p2504) for multiturn encoders
2. Motor encoder with position tracking for measuring gear:
p2506 * p0412 * p2505 / p2504
3. Motor encoder with position tracking for load gear
p2506 * p2721 * p0433 / p0432
4. Motor encoder with position tracking for load and measuring gear
p2506 * p2721
5. Direct encoder without position tracking
p2506 * p0433 / p0432
p2506 * p0433 * p0421 / p0432 for multiturn encoders
6. Direct encoder with position tracking for measuring gear
p2506 * p0412

extra.fault_value:
1: The position actual value (r2521) has exceeded the value range.
2: The encoder position actual value Gn_XIST2 (r0483) or the absolute value after the load gear (r2723) has
exceeded the value range.
3: The maximum encoder value times the factor to convert the absolute position (r0483 and/or r2723) from incre-
ments to length units (LU) has exceeded the value range for displaying the position actual value.

nume: LR: Drive Data Set changeover in operation
cauza:
A drive data set changeover (DDS changeover) when the mechanical relationships change (p2503 .. 2506), the
direction of rotation (p1821) or the encoder assignment (p2502) were requested during operation.
remediu: To changeover the drive data set, initially, exit the "operation" mode.

nume: LR: Reference function interrupted
cauza:
An activated reference function (reference mark search or measuring probe evaluation) was interrupted.
- an encoder fault has occurred (Gn_ZSW.15 = 1).
- position actual value was set during an activated reference function.
- simultaneously activate reference mark search and measuring probe evaluation (BI: p2508 and BI: p2509 = 1 sig-
nal).
- activated reference function (reference mark search or measuring probe evaluation) was deactivated (BI: p2508
and BI: p2509 = 0 signal).
remediu:
- check the causes and resolve.
- reset the control (BI: p2508 and BI: p2509 = 0 signal) and activate the requested function.

nume: EPOS: Enable not possible
cauza: It is not possible to enable the basic positioner because at least one signal is missing.
remediu: Check the appropriate binector inputs and signals.

extra.alarm_value:
1: EPOS enable missing (BI: p2656).
2: Position actual value, valid feedback signal missing (BI: p2658).

nume: LR: Position setting value activated
cauza:
The position actual value is set to the value received via CI: p2515while BI: p2514 = 1 signal. A possible system
deviation cannot be corrected.
remediu:
None necessary.
The alarm automatically disappears with BI: p2514 = 0 signal.

nume: LR: Measuring probe evaluation not possible
cauza: When evaluating the measuring probe, an error occurred.
remediu:
Deactivate the measuring probe evaluation (BI: p2509 = 0 signal).
Re alarm value = 6:
Set the input terminal for the measuring probe (p0488, p0489 or p2517, p2518).
Re alarm value = 4098:
Check the Control Unit hardware.
Re alarm value = 4100:
Reduce the frequency of the measuring pulses at the measuring probe.
Re alarm value > 50000:
Set the clock cycle ratio of the measuring clock cycle to the position controller clock cycle to an integer multiple.
To do this, the currently effective measuring clock cycle can be determined from the alarm value as follows:
Tmeas [125 µs] = alarm value - 50000
With PROFIBUS, the measuring clock cycle corresponds to the PROFIBUS clock cycle (r2064[1]).
Without PROFIBUS, the measuring clock cycle is an internal cycle time that cannot be influenced.

extra.alarm_value:
6: The input terminal for the measuring probe is not set.
4098: Error when initializing the measuring probe.
4100: The measuring pulse frequency is too high.
> 50000: The measuring clock cycle is not a multiple integer of the position controller clock cycle.

nume: EPOS: Reversing cam approached with the incorrect traversing direction
cauza:
The reversing cam MINUS was approached in the positive traversing direction or the reversing cam PLUS was
approached in the negative traversing direction.
remediu:
- check the wiring of the reversing cam (BI: p2613, BI: p2614).
- check the traversing direction to approach the reversing cam.

nume: Drive: Power unit data set PDS not configured
cauza:
Only for controlled line supply infeed/regenerative feedback units:
The power unit data set was not configured - this means that a data set number was not entered into the drive data
set.
remediu: The index of the power unit data set associated with the drive data set should be entered into p0185.

extra.fault_value: Drive data set number of p0185.

nume: Drive: Motor Data Set MDS not configured
cauza:
Only for power units:
The motor data set was not configured - this means that a data set number was not entered into the associated drive
data set.
remediu: The index of the motor data set associated with the drive data set should be entered into p0186.

extra.fault_value: The fault value includes the drive data set number of p0186.
extra.see_also: p0186 (Motor Data Sets (MDS) number)

nume: Drive: Encoder Data Set EDS not configured
cauza:
Only for power units:
The encoder data set was not configured - this means that a data set number was not entered into the associated
drive data set.
remediu:
The index of the encoder data set associated with the drive data set should be entered into p0187 (1st encoder),
p0188 (2nd encoder) and p0189 (3rd encoder).

extra.fault_value:
The fault value includes the drive data set number of p0187, p0188 and p0189.
The fault value is increased by 100 * encoder number (e.g. for p0189: Fault value 3xx with xx = data set number).

nume: Drive: Motor data set is not assigned to a drive data set
cauza:
A motor data set is not assigned to a drive object.
All of the existing motor data sets in the drive data sets must be assigned using the MDS number (p0186[0...n]).
There must be at least as many drive data sets as motor data sets.
remediu:
In the drive data sets, assign the non-assigned motor data set using the MDS number (p0186[0...n]).
- check whether all of the motor data sets are assigned to drive data sets.
- if required, delete superfluous motor data sets.
- if required, set up new drive data sets and assign to the corresponding motor data sets.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the motor data set that has not been assigned.
extra.see_also: p0186 (Motor Data Sets (MDS) number)

nume: Drive: Component number missing
cauza:
A Drive Data Set (DDS) is assigned to a Motor Data Set (MDS) or Encoder Data Set (EDS) that does not have a
component number.
remediu:
In the drive data sets, no longer assign MDS/EDS using p0186, p0187, p0188, p0189 or set a valid component num-
ber.

extra.alarm_value:
nnmmmxxyyy
nn: Number of the MDS/EDS.
mmm: Parameter number of the missing component number.
xx: Number of the DDS that is assigned to the MDS/EDS.
yyy: Parameter number that references the MDS/EDS.
Example:
p0186[7] = 5: DDS 7 is assigned MDS 5.
p0131[5] = 0: There is no component number set in MDS 5.
Alarm value = 0513107186

nume: Drive: Identical encoder in the drive data set
cauza:
More than one encoder with identical component number is assigned to a single drive data set. In one drive data set,
it is not permissible that identical encoders are operated together.
remediu: Assign the drive data set to different encoders.

extra.fault_value:
1000 * first identical encoder + 100 * second identical encoder + drive data set.
Example:
In drive data set 3, the first (p0187[3]) and second encoder (p0188[3]) are identical.
extra.see_also:
p0141 (Encoder interface (Sensor Module) component number), p0187 (Encoder 1 encoder data set num-
ber), p0188 (Encoder 2 encoder data set number), p0189 (Encoder 3 encoder data set number)

nume: Drive: Encoder used a multiple number of times
cauza:
Each encoder may only be assigned to one drive and within a drive must - in each drive data set - either always be
encoder 1, always encoder 2 or always encoder 3. This unique assignment has been violated.
remediu: Correct the double use of a component number using the two parameters coded in the fault value.

extra.fault_value:
The two parameters in coded form, that refer to the same component number.
First parameter:
Index: First and second decimal place (99 for EDS, not assigned DDS)
Parameter number: Third decimal place (1 for p0187, 2 for p0188, 3 for p0189, 4 for EDS not assigned DDS)
Drive number: Fourth and fifth decimal place
Second parameter:
Index: Sixth and seventh decimal place (99 for EDS, not assigned DDS)
Parameter number: Eighth decimal place (1 for p0187, 2 for p0188, 3 for p0189, 4 for EDS, not assigned DDS)
Drive number: Ninth and tenth decimal place
extra.see_also: p0141 (Encoder interface (Sensor Module) component number)

nume: Drive: Encoder data set changeover cannot be parameterized
cauza:
Using p0141, a changeover of the encoder data set is prepared that is illegal. In this firmware release, an encoder
data set changeover is only permitted for the components in the actual topology.
remediu:
Every encoder data set must be assigned its own dedicated DRIVE-CLiQ socket. The component numbers of the
encoder interfaces (p0141) must have different values within a drive object.
The following must apply:
p0141[0] not equal to p0141[1] not equal to ... not equal to p0141[n]

extra.alarm_value: Incorrect EDS data set number.
extra.see_also:
p0187 (Encoder 1 encoder data set number), p0188 (Encoder 2 encoder data set number), p0189
(Encoder 3 encoder data set number)

nume: Drive: Data structure does not correspond to the interface module
cauza:
The interface mode "SIMODRIVE 611 universal" was set (p2038 = 1) and the data structure does not correspond to
this mode.
For the data structure, the following rule must be complied with.
Within the group of 8 drive data sets, the assignment to the motor data set must be set the same:
p0186[0] = p0186[1] = ... = p0186[7]
p0186[8] = p0186[9] = ... = p0186[15]
p0186[16] = p0186[17] = ... = p0186[23]
p0186[24] = p0186[25] = ... = p0186[31]
remediu:
- structure the data according to the rules of the "SIMODRIVE 611 universal" interface mode.
- check the interface mode (p2038).

extra.see_also:
p0180 (Number of Drive Data Sets (DDS)), p0186 (Motor Data Sets (MDS) number), p2038 (PROFIdrive
STW/ZSW interface mode)

nume: Drive: Power unit and motor incorrectly connected
cauza:
A power unit (via PDS) was assigned to a motor (via MDS) in a drive data set that is not connected in the target
topology.
remediu:
- assign the drive data set to a combination of motor and power unit permitted by the target topology.
- adapt the target topology.

extra.alarm_value: Number of the incorrectly parameterized drive data set.
extra.see_also:
p0121 (Power unit component number), p0131 (Motor component number), p0186 (Motor Data Sets
(MDS) number)

nume: Drive: Re-commission the data set
cauza:
The assignment between the drive data set and motor data set (p0186) or between the drive data set and the
encoder data set was modified (p0187). This is the reason that the drive data set must re-commissioned.
remediu: Commission the drive data set specified in the fault value (r0949).

extra.fault_value: Drive data set to be re-commissioned.

nume: Drive: Encoder data set changeover incorrectly parameterized
cauza:
An MDS cannot have different motor encoders in two different DDS.
The following parameterization therefore results results in an error:
p0186[0] = 0, p0187[0] = 0
p0186[0] = 0, p0187[0] = 1
remediu:
If you wish to operate a motor once with one motor encoder and then another time with the other motor encoder,
then you must set up two different MDSs, in which the motor data are the same.
Example:
p0186[0] = 0, p0187[0] = 0
p0186[0] = 1, p0187[0] = 1

extra.alarm_value: The lower 16 bits indicate the first DDS and the upper 16 bits indicate the second DDS.

nume: Drive: Motor data set changeover incorrectly parameterized
cauza:
The system has identified that two motor data sets were incorrectly parameterized.
Parameter r0313 (calculated from p0314, p0310, p0311), r0315 and p1982 may only have different values if the
motor data sets are assigned different motors. p0827 is used to assign the motors and/contactors.
It is not possible to toggle between motor data sets.
remediu: Correct the parameterization of the motor data sets.

extra.alarm_value:
xxxxyyyy:
xxxx: First DDS with assigned MDS, yyyy: Second DDS with assigned MDS

nume: Drive: Motor changeover incorrectly parameterized
cauza:
With the setting p0833.0 = 1, a motor changeover via the application is selected. This is the reason that p0827 must
have different values in the appropriate motor data set.
remediu:
- parameterize the appropriate motor data sets differently (p0827).
- select the setting p0833.0 = 0 (motor changeover via the drive).

extra.alarm_value:
xxxxyyyy:
xxxx: First MDS, yyyy: Second MDS

nume: Drive: Motor cannot be changed over
cauza: The motor cannot be changed over.
remediu:
Re alarm value = 1:
Set the speed lower than the speed at the start of field weakening (r0063 < p0348).
Re alarm value = 2, 3:
Check the feedback signals of the contactor involved.

extra.alarm_value:
1:
The contactor for the motor that is presently active cannot be opened, because for a synchronous motor, the speed
(r0063) is greater than the speed at the start of field weakening (p3048). As long as r0063 > p0348, the current in
the motor does not decay in spite of the pulses being suppressed.
2:
The "contactor opened" feedback signal was not detected within 1 s.
3:
The "contactor closed" feedback signal was not detected within 1 s.

nume: Drive: Drive Data Set DDS not present
cauza: The selected drive data set is not available (p0837 > p0180). The drive data set was not changed over.
remediu:
- select the existing drive data set.
- set up additional drive data sets.

nume: Drive: Data set changeover not possible
cauza:
The selected drive data set changeover and the assigned motor changeover are not possible and are not carried out.
For synchronous motors, the motor contactor may only be switched for actual speeds less than the speed at the start
of field weakening (r0063 < p0348).
remediu: Reduce the speed below the speed at the start of field weakening.

extra.see_also: r0063 (Actual speed value)

nume: Drive: Not possible to reset encoder parameters
cauza:
When carrying out a factory setting (e.g. using p0970 = 1), it was not possible to reset the encoder parameters. The
encoder parameters are directly read out of the encoder via DRIVE-CLiQ.
remediu:
- repeat the operation.
- check the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.

extra.alarm_value: Component number of the encoder involved.
extra.reaction_upon_f: NONE (IASC/DCBRAKE, OFF1, OFF2, OFF3, STOP1, STOP2)

nume: Drive encoder: No commutation angle information
cauza:
The commutation angle information is missing. This means that synchronous motors cannot be controlled (closed-
loop control)
remediu:
Re fault cause = 1:
- check the encoder parameterization (p0404).
- use an encoder with track C/D, EnDat interface of Hall sensors.
- use an encoder with sinusoidal A/B track for which the motor pole pair number (r0313) is an integer multiple of the
encoder pulse number (p0408).
- activate the pole position identification routine (p1982 = 1).
Re fault cause = 2:
- the quotient of the pole pair number divided by the ratio of the measuring gear must be an integer number: (p0314
* p0433) / p0432.

extra.fault_value:
yyyyxxxx dec: yyyy = fault cause, xxxx = drive data set
yyyy = 1 dec:
The motor encoder used does not supply an absolute commutation angle.
yyyy = 2 dec:
The selected ratio of the measuring gear does not match the motor pole pair number.
extra.see_also:
p0402 (Gearbox type selection), p0404 (Encoder configuration effective), p0432 (Gearbox factor, encoder
revolutions), p0433 (Gearbox factor, motor/load revolutions)
extra.note: For operation with track C/D, this quotient must be less than 8.

nume: Drive encoder: Encoder configuration not supported
cauza:
The requested encoder configuration is not supported. Only bits may be requested in p0404 that are signaled as
being supported by the encoder evaluation in r0456.
remediu:
- check the encoder parameterization (p0400, p0404).
- use the matching encoder evaluation (r0456).
reactie: OFF2 (IASC/DCBRAKE, NONE, OFF1, OFF3, STOP1, STOP2)

extra.message_value: Fault cause: %1, component number: %2, encoder data set: %3
extra.fault_value:
Low word low byte: Encoder data set number
Low word high byte: Component number
High word:
The encoder evaluation does not support a function selected in p0404.
1: sin/cos encoder with absolute track (this is supported by SME25).
3: Squarewave encoder (this is supported by SMC30).
4: sin/cos encoder (this is supported by SMC20, SMI20, SME20, SME25).
12: sin/cos encoder with reference mark (this is supported by SME20).
15: Commutation with zero mark for separately-excited synchronous motors with VECTORMV.
23: Resolver (this is supported by SMC10, SMI10).
65535: Other function (compare r0456 and p0404).
extra.see_also: p0404 (Encoder configuration effective), r0456 (Encoder configuration supported)

nume: Drive encoder: Sensor Module configuration not supported
cauza:
The Sensor Module does not support the requested configuration.
For incorrect p0430 (cc = 0), the following applies:
- In p0430 (requested functions), at least 1 bit was set that is not set in r0458 (supported functions) (exception: Bit
19, 28, 29, 30, 31).
- p1982 > 0 (pole position identification requested), but r0458.16 = 0 (pole position identification not supported).
For incorrect p0437 (cc = 1), the following applies:
- In p0437 (requested functions), at least 1 bit was set that is not set in r0459 (supported functions).
remediu:
- check the encoder parameterization (p0430, p0437).
- check the pole position identification routine (p1982).
- use the matching encoder evaluation (r0458, r0459).
reactie: OFF2 (IASC/DCBRAKE, NONE, OFF1, OFF3, STOP1, STOP2)

extra.message_value: Encoder data set: %1, first incorrect bit: %2, incorrect parameter: %3
extra.fault_value:
ddccbbaa hex
aa: encoder data set number
bb: first incorrect bit
cc: incorrect parameter
cc = 0: incorrect parameter is p0430
cc = 1: incorrect parameter is p0437
cc = 2: incorrect parameter is r0459
dd: reserved (always 0)

nume: Drive encoder: Configuration position tracking
cauza:
The configuration of the position tracking is not supported.
Position tracking can only be activated for absolute encoders.
For linear axes, it is not possible to simultaneously activate the position tracking for load and measuring gears.
remediu:
- use an absolute encoder.
- if necessary, deselect the position tracking (p0411 for the measuring gear, p2720 for the load gear).
- use a Control Unit with sufficient NVRAM.
- Only activate position tracking of the load gear in the same encoder data set if the gear ratio (p2504, p2505), axis
type (p2720.1) and tolerance window (p2722) are also the same.
reactie: OFF2 (IASC/DCBRAKE, NONE, OFF1, OFF3, STOP1, STOP2)

extra.message_value: Component number: %1, encoder data set: %2, drive data set: %3, fault cause: %4
extra.fault_value:
ddccbbaa hex
aa = encoder data set
bb = component number
cc = drive data set
dd = fault cause
dd = 00 hex = 0 dez
An absolute encoder is not being used.
dd = 01 hex = 1 dez
Position tracking cannot be activated because the memory of the internal NVRAM is not sufficient or a Control Unit
does not have an NVRAM.
dd = 02 hex = 2 dez
For a linear axis, the position tracking was activated for the load and measuring gear.
dd = 03 hex = 3 dez
Position tracking cannot be activated because position tracking with another gear ratio, axis type or tolerance window
has already been detected for this encoder data set.
dd = 04 hex = 4 dez
A linear encoder is being used.
extra.see_also: p0404 (Encoder configuration effective), p0411 (Measuring gear, configuration)

nume: Measuring gear: Position tracking, maximum actual value exceeded
cauza:
When the position tracking of the measuring gear is configured, the drive/encoder identifies a maximum possible
absolute position actual value (r0483) that cannot be represented within 32 bits.
Maximum value: p0408 * p0412 * 2^p0419
remediu:
- reduce the fine resolution (p0419).
- reduce the multiturn resolution (p0412).

extra.fault_value:
Low word low byte: Encoder data set number
Low word high byte: Component number
extra.see_also:
p0408 (Rotary encoder pulse No.), p0412 (Measuring gear, absolute encoder, rotary, revolutions, virtual),
p0419 (Fine resolution absolute value Gx_XIST2 (in bits))
p0412 (Measuring gear, absolute encoder, rotary, revolutions, virtual), p0419 (Fine resolution absolute
value Gx_XIST2 (in bits))

nume: Encoder 1: Reference point coordinate not in the permissible range
cauza:
The reference point coordinate received when adjusting the encoder via connector input CI:p2599 lies outside the
half of the encoder range and cannot be set as actual axis position. The maximum permissible value is displayed in
the supplementary information.
remediu: Set the reference point coordinate less than the value from the supplementary information.

nume: Encoder 2: Reference point coordinate not in the permissible range
cauza:
The reference point coordinate received when adjusting the encoder via connector input CI:p2599 lies outside the
half of the encoder range and cannot be set as actual axis position. The maximum permissible value is displayed in
the supplementary information.
remediu: Set the reference point coordinate less than the value from the supplementary information.

nume: Encoder 3: Reference point coordinate not in the permissible range
cauza:
The reference point coordinate received when adjusting the encoder via connector input CI:p2599 lies outside the
half of the encoder range and cannot be set as actual axis position. The maximum permissible value is displayed in
the supplementary information.
remediu: Set the reference point coordinate less than the value from the supplementary information.

nume: Drive encoder: Number of pulses is not to the power of two

nume: Encoder could not be identified
cauza:
During encoder identification (waiting) with p0400 = 10100, the encoder could not be identified.
Either the wrong encoder has been installed or no encoder has been installed, the wrong encoder cable has been
connected or no encoder cable has been connected to the Sensor Module, or the DRIVE-CLiQ component has not
been connected to DRIVE-CLiQ.
remediu:
- check and, if necessary, connect the encoder and/or encoder cable.
- check and, if necessary, establish the DRIVE-CLiQ connection.
- in the case of encoders that cannot be identified (e.g. encoders without EnDat interface), the correct encoder type
must be entered in p0400.

extra.note:
Encoder identification must be supported by the encoder and is possible in the following cases:
Encoder with EnDat interface, motor with DRIVE-CLiQ.

nume: Drive: Motor encoder not ready
cauza:

- initialization of encoder 1 (motor encoder) was unsuccessful.
- the function "parking encoder" is active (encoder control word G1_STW.14 = 1).
- the encoder interface (Sensor Module) is deactivated (p0145).
- the Sensor Module is defective.
remediu: Evaluate other queued faults via encoder 1.

nume: Drive: Encoderless operation due to a fault active

Check the Control Unit hardware.
Re alarm value = 4100:

Re alarm value = 4200:

tiple.

ments to length units (LU) has exceeded the value range for displaying the position actual value.

nume: Encoder 1: Adjustment not possible
cauza:
The maximum encoder value times the factor to convert the absolute position (r0483 and/or r2723) from increments
to length units (LU) has exceeded the value range (-2147483648 ... 2147483647) for displaying the position actual
value.
remediu:
If the value for the maximum possible absolute position (LU) is greater than 4294967296, then it is not possible to
make an adjustment due to an overflow.
For rotary encoders, the maximum possible absolute position (LU) is calculated as follows:
1. Motor encoder without position tracking:
p2506 * p0433 * p2505 / (p0432 * p2504)
p2506 * p0433 * p2505 * p0421 / (p0432 * p2504) for multiturn encoders
2. Motor encoder with position tracking for measuring gear:
p2506 * p0412 * p2505 / p2504
3. Motor encoder with position tracking for load gear:
p2506 * p2721 * p0433 / p0432
4. Motor encoder with position tracking for load and measuring gear:
p2506 * p2721
5. Direct encoder without position tracking:
p2506 * p0433 / p0432
p2506 * p0433 * p0421 / p0432 for multiturn encoders
6. Direct encoder with position tracking for measuring gear:
p2506 * p0412

3. Motor encoder with position tracking for load gear:
p2506 * p2721 * p0433 / p0432
4. Motor encoder with position tracking for load and measuring gear:
p2506 * p2721

p2506 * p0433 / p0432
p2506 * p0433 * p0421 / p0432 for multiturn encoders

nume: Drive: No power unit present
cauza:
The power unit parameters cannot be read or no parameters are stored in the power unit.
Connection between the Control Unit and the Motor Module was interrupted or is defective.
remediu:
- connect the data line to power unit and restart the Control Unit (POWER ON).
- check or replace the Control Unit.
- check the cable between the Control Unit and Motor Module.
- after correcting the topology, the parameters must be again downloaded using the commissioning software.

extra.see_also: r0200 (Power unit code number actual)
extra.note:
This fault also occurs if an incorrect topology was selected in the commissioning software and this parameterization
is then downloaded to the Control Unit.

nume: Drive: Motor overcurrent
cauza:
The permissible motor limit current was exceeded.
- effective current limit set too low.
- current controller not correctly set.
- V/f operation: Up ramp was set too short or the load is too high.
- V/f operation: Short-circuit in the motor cable or ground fault.
- V/f operation: Motor current does not match current of power unit.
- Switch to rotating motor without flying restart function (p1200).
remediu:
- check the current limits (p0640).
- vector control: Check the current controller (p1715, p1717).
- V/f control: Check the current limiting controller (p1340 ... p1346).
- increase the up ramp (p1120) or reduce the load.
- check the motor and motor cables for short-circuit and ground fault.
- check the motor for the star-delta configuration and rating plate parameterization.
- check the power unit and motor combination.
- Choose "flying restart" function (p1200) if switched to rotating motor.

extra.note: Limit current = 2 * Minimum( p0640, 4 * p0305) >= 2 * p0305

nume: Drive: Infeed or power unit not ready
cauza:
After an internal power-on command, the infeed or drive does not signal ready.
- monitoring time is too short.
- DC link voltage is not present.
- associated infeed or drive of the signaling component is defective.
- supply voltage incorrectly set.
remediu:
- increase the monitoring time (p0857).
- ensure that there is a DC link voltage. Check the DC link busbar. Enable the infeed.
- replace the associated infeed or drive of the signaling component.
- check the line supply voltage setting (p0210).

extra.see_also: p0857 (Power unit monitoring time)

nume: Drive: Power unit overload I2t
cauza:
Alarm threshold for I2t overload (p0294) of the power unit exceeded.
The response parameterized in p0290 becomes active.
remediu:
- reduce the continuous load.
- adapt the load duty cycle.
- check the assignment of the rated currents of the motor and Motor Module.

extra.see_also: p0290 (Power unit overload response)

nume: Drive: Power unit EEPROM without rated data
cauza: No rated data are stored in the power unit EEPROM.
remediu: Replace the power unit or inform Siemens Customer Service.

extra.see_also:
p0205 (Power unit application), r0206 (Rated power unit power), r0207 (Rated power unit current), r0208
(Rated power unit line supply voltage), r0209 (Power unit, maximum current)

nume: Drive: Power unit has been changed
cauza:
The code number of the actual power unit does not match the saved number. The fault only occurs if the comparator
in p9906 or p9908 is not at f 2 (low) or 3 (minimum).
remediu:
Connect the original power unit and power up the Control Unit again (POWER ON) or set p0201 to r0200 and exit
commissioning with p0010 = 0.
If the new power unit is accepted, then if required, the current limit p0640 can be reduced by a lower maximum cur-
rent of the power unit (r0209) (torque limits stay the same).
If not only the power unit is changed, but also the motor, then the motor must be re-commissioned (e.g. using p0010
= 1). This is also necessary if motor data is still to be downloaded via DRIVE-CLiQ.
If the comparison stage in p9906 is set to 2, 3, then commissioning can be exited (p0010 = 0) and the fault acknowl-
edged.

extra.fault_value: Number of the incorrect parameter.
extra.see_also:
r0200 (Power unit code number actual), p0201 (Power unit code number)
r0200 (Power unit code number actual)

nume: Drive: Temperature sensor not connected
cauza:
The temperature sensor for motor temperature monitoring, specified in p0600, is not available.
- 10 (SME) is set in p0601, but a value other than 1, 2, or 3 is set in p0600
- 11 (SME) is set in p0601, but a value other than 20 or 21 is set in p0600
- 11 (BICO) is set in p0601, and a sensor is set in p4610 - p4613, but the associated BICO input (p0608, p0609) is
not interconnected
- module with sensor evaluation not present or has been removed in the meantime.
- temperature sensor via Motor Module, not for CU310.
remediu:
- connect the module with temperature sensor.
- set the available temperature sensor (p0600, p0601).
- set p4610 - p4613 to no sensor (0), or interconnect p0608 and p0609 with an external sensor value (only if BICO
(11) is set in p0601)

extra.see_also: p0600 (Motor temperature sensor for monitoring), p0601 (Motor temperature sensor type)

nume: Drive: Simulation mode activated
cauza:
The simulation mode is activated.
The drive can only be powered up if the DC link voltage is less than 40 V.
remediu: The alarm automatically disappears if simulation mode is deactivated with p1272 = 0.

nume: Drive: Simulation mode with DC link voltage too high
cauza: The simulation mode is activated and the DC link voltage is greater than the permissible value of 40 V.
remediu:
- switch out (disable) simulation mode (p1272 = 0) and acknowledge the fault.
- reduce the input voltage in order to reach a DC link voltage below 40 V.

nume: Drive: Infeed operation missing
cauza:
The signal "infeed operation" is not present although the enable signals for the drive have been present for longer
than the parameterized monitoring time (p0857).
- infeed not operational.
- interconnection of the binector input for the ready signal is either incorrect or missing (p0864).
- infeed is presently carrying out a line supply identification routine.
remediu:
- bring the infeed into an operational state.
- check the interconnection of the binector input for the signal "infeed operation" (p0864).
- increase the monitoring time (p0857).
- wait until the infeed has completed the line supply identification routine.

extra.see_also: p0857 (Power unit monitoring time), p0864 (Infeed operation)

nume: Drive: Infeed operation withdrawn
cauza:
The signal "infeed operation" was withdrawn in operation.
- interconnection of the binector input for the signal "infeed operation" is either incorrect or missing (p0864).
- the enable signals of the infeed were disabled.
- due to a fault, the infeed withdraws the signal "infeed operation".
remediu:
- check the interconnection of the binector input for the "infeed operation" signal (p0864).
- check the enable signals of the infeed and if required, enable.
- remove and acknowledge an infeed fault.

extra.note:
If this drive is intended to back up the DC link regeneratively, then the fault response must be parameterized for
NONE, OFF1 or OFF3. so that the drive can continue to operate even after the infeed fails.

The condition for this external alarm is fulfilled.
remediu: Eliminate the causes of this alarm.

extra.see_also: p2106 (External fault 1)
